purpose: B4-4 rule calibration input. Real observed connection metadata from an A4-3 real-device run. NOT synthetic ground truth; NOT an oracle. Contains NO expected riskLevel / matchedRules / category verdicts.
selectionMethod: Representative sample drawn from the real Room DB (causalguard.db) pulled from the device via run-as after the 2026-10-05 A4-3 re-run. Rows were selected by targeted SQL queries to cover, with real observed values: (a) attributed (uid>=0) with domainHint, (b) attributed without domainHint, (c) uid=-1/packageName=unknown with domainHint (TCP), (d) uid=-1/packageName=unknown without domainHint (ICMP + TCP), and (e) blocked=true (TCP tracker blocks from com.jingdong.app.mall / com.shark.jizhang / com.netease.cloudmusic, plus a UDP:53 DNS block). Selection collapses duplicate repeat connections (same tuple) to avoid over-weighting; package mix roughly follows the observed distribution (idlefish/weibo/pinduoduo/xhs/emmx/wechat/taobao dominant, plus unknown degradations).

redactedFields.remoteIp: Field redaction. Real observed IPs replaced by IANA documentation ranges preserving address family only: IPv4 -> 203.0.113.0/24, IPv6 -> 2001:db8::/32, with a deterministic per-address counter. These are NOT the real target IPs; only IPv4-vs-IPv6 family is faithful.
redactedFields.eventId: Synthetic stable identifiers (a4r-XXXX) assigned in chronological order; the real Room eventIds (which embed raw ip:port) are not exported.
redactedFields.uid: Kept as-is for attributed rows (real per-app Linux UIDs), 0 for the system DNS-block row, -1 for unattributed. uid is required for attribution calibration; it is not a device identifier.

timestampTransformation.note: Every selected row carries its real capture timestamp from the Room DB.
timestampTransformation.transformation: Uniform shift (de-identification of wall-clock): subtract the earliest selected timestamp 1791194582719 so the first event maps to 0. Real ordering and real inter-event intervals are preserved exactly (0 .. 251869 ms); the span is unchanged by the uniform shift.

packageNamePolicy: Public Android package names kept where the base attributed them (e.g. com.taobao.idlefish, com.sina.weibo, com.xunmeng.pinduoduo, com.xingin.xhs, com.microsoft.emmx, com.tencent.mm, com.taobao.taobao, com.jingdong.app.mall, com.shark.jizhang, com.netease.cloudmusic). Unattributed connections honestly kept as packageName=unknown with uid=-1. Attribution follows B4-3 semantics: packageName=unknown means not attributable to a specific App, regardless of uid; thus a4r-0019 (uid=0, a system DNS-block row) is NOT counted as attributed-to-App even though its uid >= 0.
domainHintPolicy: Only domains actually observed in this capture are retained; nothing guessed. Empty domainHint means the connection had no DNS hint at capture time (including the blocked UDP:53 DNS row and the uid=-1 ICMP/TCP rows).
blockedPolicy: blocked=true samples come from the real run with the base block list enabled: TCP tracker domains (pangolin/ctobsnssdk/baidustatic/umeng for com.shark.jizhang, api.m.jd.com for com.jingdong.app.mall, interface3.music.163.com for com.netease.cloudmusic) and a UDP:53 DNS block (unknown, no domainHint).
oracleDisclosure: This fixture provides REAL OBSERVED INPUT only. It intentionally contains no expected riskLevel, no matchedRules, and no category verdicts. The oracle for B4-4 must be authored independently by member B; the current rule-engine output must NOT be treated as ground truth.

provenance.evidenceSource: Room DB (causalguard.db + wal + shm) pulled 2026-10-05 from device via `adb shell run-as com.causalguard cat databases/causalguard.db` after the A4-3 re-run (both com.causalguard and net.kollnig.missioncontrol.fdroid.test reinstalled; base VPN enabled with block list).

statement: Entries are selected/redacted from real observed events, not synthetic ground truth.
